faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Kalyani Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree or a Second Class Post Graduate Degree with PhD. Specialization in Nutrition/Dietetics is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided and should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 61,600 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this AIIMS Kalyani recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written/Aptitude Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position at AIIMS Kalyani?
faq.answer: The position of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is AIIMS Kalyani located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Kalyani is located in Kalyani, West Bengal.
